definitions.explanation: A relatively small number or group compared to the whole.
A number less than one expressed with a decimal point.

examples.japanese: {少数|しょうすう}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The opinions of the minority are also important.

examples.japanese: {少数|しょうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
{少数|しょうすう}⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧する。
{少数|しょうすう}⟦{第二|だいに}→第二：noentry⟧⟦{位|い}→位：00443_i⟧まで⟦{求|もと}めなさい→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Calculate to the second decimal place.

examples.japanese: 0.5⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少数|しょうすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}した→表す：01868_arawasu⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: 0.5 is a number expressed as a decimal.

notes:
{少数|しょうすう} has two distinct meanings: minority/small number and decimal (mathematics).

MEANING 1 - MINORITY:
- {少数|しょうすう}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧: minority group
- {少数|しょうすう}⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧: ethnic minority
- {少数|しょうすう}⟦{精鋭|せいえい}→精鋭：noentry⟧: select few, elite group
- {少数|しょうすう}⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: minority opinion

MEANING 2 - DECIMAL:
- {少数|しょうすう}⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: decimal point
- {少数|しょうすう}⟦{第一|だいいち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧⟦{位|い}→位：00443_i⟧: first decimal place

CONTRAST:
- {少数|しょうすう}: minority, few
- {多数|たすう}: majority, many
- {多数決|たすうけつ}: majority vote

NOTE:
Don't confuse with {小数|しょうすう} (also decimal) which uses different kanji but has the same reading.
